clue.text: Introduces fast way to travel round about

indicators.note: round means the travel phrase is wrapped around the abbreviation for about

parts.note: travelling fast is going in jets: IN JETS
C, short for circa, is Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone presents the speediest way to get somewhere, going round the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean bringing something in, as a newcomer or a substance is put into a system.

clue.text: Sloth and one near it disturbed

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of near it are shaken up

explanation.surface: A sloth and someone near it are both upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sloth' looks like the animal but is the vice of laziness.
explanation.definitionFit: Laziness and lack of energy to move or act are the same idea.

clue.text: Jack was obliged to limit one fervent crusade

indicators.note: to limit means the other pieces enclose the letter for one

parts.note: J abbreviates jack in cards
had, as in 'had to go', means was obliged
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Jack had to rein in one zealous campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arabic term for a holy war or struggle for the faith is a religious campaign.

clue.text: Italian lake draws in British musicians

indicators.note: draws in means the lake's name takes the letter inside it

parts.note: Lake Como is in northern Italy

explanation.surface: An Italian lake resort attracts British musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: A small band, especially of jazz players, is a group of instrumentalists.

clue.text: Bizarre uniform on bishop in confirmation

indicators.note: in means the two pieces go inside the word for confirmation

parts.note: a seal confirms a document as genuine

indicators.note: on means, in this down clue, the uniform letter sits above the bishop

parts.note: Uniform is U in the NATO phonetic alphabet
RR, Right Reverend, is a bishop's title

explanation.surface: A bishop in strange vestments at a confirmation service.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreamlike and weird, in the manner of Dali's paintings, means strange.

clue.text: Less like lamb from this supplier?

definitions.text: Less like lamb from this supplier?

parts.words: Less like lamb from this supplier?
parts.note: a meat trader supplies lamb, and read as a comparative of butch, the word means more macho, less lamb-like and meek

explanation.surface: A shopper wonders whether this tradesman's meat is less lamb-like than expected.
explanation.walkthrough: Two readings meet: the meat supplier who sells lamb, and 'more butch', the opposite of gentle as a lamb.
explanation.definitionFit: A meat retailer supplies lamb, and the comparative of butch describes someone tougher, unlike a meek lamb.

clue.text: Liberal dons tolerate American state

indicators.note: dons means puts on, so the verb for tolerate wears the letter for Liberal

parts.note: to bear is to tolerate

explanation.surface: A Liberal puts up with American statehood.
explanation.definitionFit: The country between Poland and Russia is a sovereign nation.

clue.text: Did deal concealing gain: it's a blow

indicators.note: concealing means the verb for did deal hides the word for gain within it

parts.note: traded means did a deal
to win is to gain

explanation.surface: A trader hid profits: what a blow to investors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blow' suggests a setback; it is a wind blowing.
explanation.definitionFit: A steady tropical wind blows reliably towards the equator, so it is literally a blow.

clue.text: Torment tedious type outside electronic plant

indicators.note: outside means the two pieces surround the electronic letter between them

parts.note: hell is torment
a bore is a tedious person
E abbreviates electronic, as in e-mail

explanation.surface: A dull person tormented outside an electronics plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like a factory; it is a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The Christmas rose is one of this genus of poisonous flowering perennials.

clue.text: Extremely rude characters in seaside towns

indicators.note: extremely means the outer letters of rude are taken

parts.note: sorts means characters or types of person

explanation.surface: Very rude people are found in coastal towns.
explanation.definitionFit: Holiday places by the sea are where visitors go for leisure.

clue.text: Passing here, MP befuddled with ale

indicators.note: befuddled, as if confused by drink, signals that the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A member of parliament wanders past, muddled after drinking beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something passing lasts only briefly, which is the sense of short-lived.

clue.text: Hold-up man in downbeat LA suburb

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words downbeat LA suburb

explanation.surface: A robber is lurking in a gloomy Los Angeles neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hold-up man' suggests a robber; it is the Titan who holds up the heavens.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Titan was condemned to hold up the sky on his shoulders.

clue.text: Young creature to leap explosively across delta

indicators.note: across means the shuffled letters stretch over the single letter
explosively means the letters of to leap are blown apart and rearranged

parts.note: Delta is D in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A young animal is about to bound wildly over a river delta.
explanation.definitionFit: A larva of a frog or toad is a young amphibian, still living in water.

clue.text: Wildlife rights protecting old English river

indicators.note: protecting means the two letters for rights guard the other pieces between them

parts.note: R abbreviates right, so rights gives two Rs
the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland

explanation.surface: A campaign for animal rights shields an old English river.
explanation.definitionFit: This small deer is an example of the animals found in the wild in Britain.

clue.text: Cool Paris trashed Athenian citadel

indicators.note: trashed means wrecked, so the letters of Cool Paris are scrambled

explanation.surface: Fashionable Paris has been wrecked, as a review might say.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient fortified hilltop of Athens, home of the Parthenon, carries this name.

clue.text: Check others taking exercise inside

indicators.note: taking means the word for others takes another piece into itself
inside confirms the exercise word goes within

parts.note: the rest means the others
to train is to exercise

explanation.surface: Checking whether the others are working out indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A check on behaviour is a curb or holding back.

clue.text: Show main tempo needs changing

indicators.note: needs changing means the letters of main tempo must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A conductor says the main tempo of the show must change.
explanation.definitionFit: A Christmas stage entertainment for families is a type of theatrical production.

clue.text: Jeremy the player for certain clubs

definitions.meaning: Jeremy, the English actor of Reversal of Fortune and Brideshead Revisited
golf clubs with metal heads, numbered for different distances

explanation.surface: A golfer named Jeremy selects particular clubs from the bag.
explanation.definitionFit: The actor's surname is also the name for a class of metal-headed golf clubs.

clue.text: Fighter back on horse yet losing every second?

indicators.note: back means the letters kept are read in reverse order
losing every second letter keeps alternate letters of on horse yet

explanation.surface: A jockey back on his horse, yet dropping time every second.
explanation.walkthrough: From 'on horse yet' keep the even letters N, O, S, Y, T, then read them backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Mike, the heavyweight boxing champion, is the famous fighter of this surname.

clue.text: Lots following letter dictated: those in hot water?

indicators.note: following means the word for lots comes after the sounded letter
dictated means spoken, so the letter is heard as a drink

parts.note: the letter T, said out loud
bags, as in bags of time, means lots

explanation.surface: Lots of people after a dictated letter find themselves in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In hot water' means in trouble, but here it is literal: brewing in a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: Little sachets of leaves are dunked in a cup of boiling water to brew.

clue.text: Former writer accepting end, tense, is suitable

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: accepting means the writing tool takes the word for end into itself

parts.note: a pen is a writing implement
to die is to come to an end
T abbreviates tense in grammar

explanation.surface: An ex-writer, nervous about the end, finds it fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: An action that is advantageous or convenient in the circumstances is fitting for the purpose.

clue.text: Medical speciality doubled European understanding

indicators.note: doubled means the speciality's letters appear twice

parts.note: ENT is ear, nose and throat medicine

explanation.surface: A medical speciality doubles as a European agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A friendly agreement between nations, as in Entente Cordiale, is a diplomatic accord.

clue.text: Less colourful second city?

parts.note: paler means less colourful
a mo is a moment or second

explanation.surface: A drab city that ranks second.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second city' suggests a country's runner-up city; 'second' is MO.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Sicily is a large Italian city.

clue.text: Flow alternatively seen in Midlands river

indicators.note: seen in means the word for alternatively appears inside the river's name

parts.note: the Trent flows through the English Midlands
or means alternatively

explanation.surface: Another way of seeing the flow of a river in the Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent rushing stream or outpouring is a strong flow.

clue.text: Character seen with drink: John Lennon for one!

parts.note: an air is a manner or character, as in an air of mystery
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: A personality spotted with a drink: the Beatle himself.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition names Liverpool's John Lennon Airport, not the musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Liverpool's airfield was renamed after the Beatle, making it an example of a named aviation hub.

clue.text: Driver awaiting chance to pass?

parts.note: looks like a motorist stuck behind a slow vehicle, but means a novice who has yet to pass the driving test

explanation.surface: A motorist stuck behind a lorry waits for a gap to overtake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pass' suggests overtaking; it is passing the driving test.
explanation.definitionFit: A novice motorist with L-plates is waiting to sit and succeed in the driving test.

clue.text: Climbing pea's tips concealed garden pest

indicators.note: climbing, in a down clue, means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: the end letters of the word pea
hid means concealed

explanation.surface: Hidden at the top of a climbing pea plant is a garden pest.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenfly and blackfly are sap-sucking insects that damage garden plants.

clue.text: Trap quickly springs up — end of mouse!

indicators.note: springs up, in a down clue, means the word for quickly is read upwards

parts.note: soon means quickly

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of mouse

explanation.surface: A trap springs shut: the end of the mouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A loop of rope that tightens when pulled is a snare.

clue.text: Defence starts to analyse legal issue behind injunction

indicators.note: starts to means the first letter of each following word is taken

explanation.surface: A lawyer begins to examine a legal point arising from a court order.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim of being elsewhere when the crime happened is a form of legal defence.

clue.text: Name potholer lost in remote region

indicators.note: lost means the letters of potholer are disoriented and reordered

explanation.surface: A caver called by name has gone missing somewhere far off.
explanation.definitionFit: The northernmost point of the Earth is about as far-flung a place as exists.

clue.text: Defiant expression from drunk in this place

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard
here means in this place

explanation.surface: A drunk in this very spot shouts something defiant.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a cry of triumph or defiance, like 'take that!'

clue.text: Weird people having time for miscellaneous article

parts.note: odd means weird
men means people

explanation.surface: Strange folk with time on their hands collect assorted bric-a-brac.
explanation.definitionFit: A leftover scrap or stray item from a set is a random piece.
